decision: Base car = 'VA WRX Full car Exterior.stl' (2024-03, 25M tris), levelled with tools/level.py (RANSAC ground -> +Z, nose +X), ground removed with tools/clean.py
why: Brief's suggested full car; it has wheels and wing. Levelled length 4,589 mm vs VA spec 4,595 mm. ive crop assumes long axis Y and would clip tyre sidewalls in this frame

decision: State/part scans used: Hood Open, Front End Bumper Removed, Front Bumper Only, Hood Scoop, Hood Scoop Removed, Fog Bezels (2024-01) and Trunk open, Rear, Wing (2024-04); all with the car's level transform, no per-part re-normalisation
why: tools/regcheck.py: all sit on the full car (median 1.7-2.9 mm, ICP correction <=4 mm / 0.1 deg; fog bezels 0.5 deg on a tiny part) - same Artec frame as the 2024-03 car

decision: Not used: Project 29 set (2023) and VA Bumper Back (2025)
why: Own frames. P29 globally registers onto the front (FPFH+RANSAC+ICP, median 3.5 mm, stable over 4 tries) but it is a different car (different wheels) and front-end only; mixing two cars in one exploded view risks visible mismatches. The 2025 file is a rear end with the bumper on, not a part. The 2024 same-car states already cover bumper off / hood open / trunk open

decision: Explode base = car minus front bumper + hood scoop (ferrari-296 composite.py), filled with the new geometry of 'Hood Scoop Removed' then 'Front End Bumper Removed'; wing split off with tools/wing_split.py
why: Lesson: splice state scans as captured over the trimmed car. Bumper/scoop zones only, so the propped hood in the bumper-removed scan never enters. Render check: exposed crash structure and scoop opening read correctly

decision: Wing part = car's own above-deck wing skin + Wing.stl (uprights/underside), cut by deck height + proximity to Wing.stl
why: Wing.stl alone lacks the blade's top skin (red overlay showed only underside/uprights), so removing it left the blade on the car. First two deck rules took the whole trunk lid / its rear lip; final rule keeps the lid, leaves only the unscanned foot pads

decision: Bumper part = Front Bumper Only with the fog-bezel zones carved out (a90 carve.py, 6 mm); fog bezels fly as their own parts
why: Bezel scans duplicate the bumper's bezel surfaces; carving avoids double skins and gives the explode two extra small layers (Temerario-style layered panels)

decision: Trunk-open shot = car with the closed lid+wing (surfaces that moved between 'Rear' and 'Trunk open', same 2024-04 session) replaced by 'Trunk open' (tools/trunk_comp.py)
why: Brief: hood/trunk open where state scans allow. Using the moved-surface diff means trunk-open coverage holes never delete car surface

decision: Hood-open shot uses 'VA WRX Hood Open' as captured (it is a whole car with the hood propped)
why: Registered to the car at 1.7 mm median; a real captured state beats a fake hinge animation (no scanned hood underside in the closed car)

decision: Hood-open shot = car with the closed hood (surfaces moved between same-session 'Hood Scoop Removed' and 'Hood Open', x>1.1 m) swapped for 'Hood Open', plus the propped hood from 'Front End Bumper Removed' (tools/add_new.py, z<1.85 m)
why: 'Hood Open' alone is a hollow shell behind the windshield and caught only fragments of the raised hood; the bumper-removed scan (same 2024-01 session, prop rod) has the hood and its underside. One floating scrap at 2.15-2.35 m excluded

decision: Tightened every wide shot (turntables 3.0-3.3 m, top-down 6.1 m overhead, explode 5.0 m) after the first framing sheet
why: Lesson (240SX): in 9:16 tighten by cropping into the car - first sheet had the car at ~40 % width; fog bezels left frame in the explode, so they now stack just ahead of the bumper

decision: Shot list (Temerario order): s01 front 3/4 turntable 5 s, s02 rear 3/4 orbit 5 s, s03 front wheel ECU, s04 grille/headlight/fog ECU, s05 wing ECU (2.5 s each, 2 mm scan), s06 hood open 3.75 s, s07 trunk open 3.75 s, s08 rise to top-down 5 s, s09 explode 8 s (separate 0.04-0.30, bumper turns 0.26-0.56, reassemble 0.60-0.86), logo
why: Brief order: turntables -> extreme close-ups -> hood/trunk open -> top-down -> exploded -> logo. Nominal lengths; final cut retimes each clip to the track's accents (setpts on smooth eased moves)

decision: Rear licence plate flattened onto its fitted plane in car, rear and hood-open scans before every composite (tools/deplate.py, after mazda-miata-na)
why: Customer registration was legible in the wing close-up and rear 3/4 framing stills; plate stays as a blank slab. Prep re-made car.json with the identical root, so --like parts stay pinned

decision: Music = subaru-wrx-va_track.mp3 (original dark UK garage/bass generated for this reel by the coordinating session). Kick-peak grid 0.4533 s = 132.4 BPM, phase 0.057 s (tools/accents.py from nissan-frontier)
why: Brief: only this track. ive beats says 66.3 BPM - half-time (onsets every 0.23 s = 16ths of 0.906). Kicks on every even beat to b30; new section at b32 (14.56 s) with half-time kicks every 4 beats from b34; last hit b64 29.07 s, -30 dB at 29.5, -41 dB by 31.8 (matches the parent's 29.3/31.8 estimate)

decision: Cuts on kick beats: s01 0, s02 b8 3.683, s03 b16 7.309, s04 b20, s05 b24, s06 hood b28, s07 trunk b34 15.468 (first half-time kick), s08 top-down b38, s09 explode b46 20.907, logo b58 26.346; reel ends ~30.8 s on the tail
why: Track is 29 s of music, so the 38 s plan is compressed: holds vary 4/6/8 beats (lesson: vary holds), every cut on a measured kick; rendered shots play ~1.38x (smooth eased moves, invisible); logo card sits under the last phrase and fades with the tail

decision: Explode re-keyed to the track before rendering (5.439 s = b46-b58): parts out by b48, bumper turns about Z b48-b51 to show its scanned inside, everything locks home on the b54 kick (24.533 s, low 0.97), assembled car holds 1.8 s
why: Lesson: separation/reassembly on accents; b54 is the strongest kick of the second section

From frame 43 the Cycles persistent-data render lost all three studio lights (render time fell 12 s -> 6.8 s/frame, frame mean 27 -> 6): the car went to a black silhouette from 23.6 s until the logo. Found on the assembled contact sheet, not in the log. Dark frames kept in renders/s09_dark for reference.

decision: Re-render s09_explode frames 61-82 with --no-persist (new shots.py flag)
why: The first re-render (frames 43-82) lost the lights again after 18 frames (first dark frame 61), so the dropout is not tied to a frame or pose. Cycles persistent data is the common factor; frames 61-82 render with it off. All other shots checked by per-frame luma: no dropouts.

decision: v2 plan: scene-director + director agents (direction.md, director.md): front -> side -> rear, sectioned bumper hero beat with labels, reuse s01/s06/s07 trimmed, 6 new shots
why: User: order by scan features, an agent directs the scenes; parent brief + user addendum: whole-car opener, no redundant sections (director flagged s01~s02~s08), bumper-removed data highlighted/labelled, no all-at-once wide explode, small logo. Wing not lifted: no wing-removed scan.
